units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:20">Y. Snh. X, 29ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>סֵיפֵיה</he> (interch. with <he>סוֹפֵיה</he>).
B. Bath. 14ᵇ; a. e.—Esp. the last (second) clause of a Biblical verse; the last section of a Mishnah &c.

<cite ref="Berakhot 60a:16">Ber. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>כל היכי … מרישיה לסיפיה … מסיפיה לרישיה וכ׳</he> whatever way you interpret that verse, whether from the first to the second clause, it gives sense, or from the second to the first clause, it gives sense.

<cite ref="Chullin 94b:5">Ḥull. 94ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אימא ס׳</he> how will you understand the last (third) clause? <cite ref="Shabbat 86a:3">Sabb. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ כר׳ וכ׳</he> the last (second) clause agrees with &c.; a. v. fr.
